description: Special prop containing whatever is nested between a component's tags. Render it with `{children}`.
Building specialized components by wrapping generic ones with specific props and children, instead of inheritance.
Any prop can carry JSX (`sidebar={<Nav />}`), giving a component several named holes to fill.
`<>...</>` or `<Fragment key>` groups siblings without adding a DOM node.
Legacy APIs to inspect or modify children. Fragile; prefer explicit props or context.
